title: Pollen checkout and tier labels
summary:
Pollen checkout gained working buttons, tier labels got clearer, and API routing got a round of fixes—with two attempted fallbacks rolled back.

Pollen pack buttons were connected to checkout for $5, $10, $20, and $50 packs, with a beta double-Pollen message on the balance card. The tier panel now distinguishes the active subscription from the target tier and reports subscription lookup errors separately.

Image and text services gained configurable gateway checks, while model-listing requests now carry the required authorization without presenting it as a generation parameter. A Portkey header correction lets Perplexity citations and other non-OpenAI response fields pass through.

A homepage change briefly replaced generation errors with fallback copy and hid failed decorative art. A later PR reverted that behavior, so the fallback is not part of the day's final merged state.
